import Ram620Leaves
namespace RHLimit.Ram620
open Real IEANTN Ramanujan640 RHContinuation.Ramanujan
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option maxRecDepth 100000
noncomputable def certifiedMargin620 (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if (640000000000:ℝ) ≤ x then sourceCertifiedMargin x else 1/1000

lemma retains_original_margin {x : ℝ} (hx : (640000000000:ℝ) ≤ x) :
    certifiedMargin620 x = sourceCertifiedMargin x := by
  simp only [certifiedMargin620,if_pos hx]

lemma onset_ratio : (620000000000:ℚ)/640000000000 = 31/32 := by norm_num

theorem actual_ramanujan_620b_profile (hRH : SharedRH.hypothesis) (hGM : GM_Q_Theorem1_1)
    (hP : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_psi) (hJ : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_riemann_pi)
    (hT1 : Buthe.v1.table_1_interval_bounds) (hT2 : Buthe.v1.table_2_interval_bounds)
    (hL : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_pi) (hU : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_gt_pi)
    (hS : Buthe2016.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_pi)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : (620000000000:ℝ) ≤ x) : certifiedMargin620 x ≤ RamStudy.RG x := by
  unfold certifiedMargin620
  split_ifs with h640
  · exact source_ramanujan_profile hRH hT2 hJ hL hU hS h640
  · exact actual_ramanujan_620b hRH hGM hP hJ hT1 hT2 hL hU hS hx

theorem actual_prime_counting_gap620 (hRH : SharedRH.hypothesis) (hGM : GM_Q_Theorem1_1)
    (hP : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_psi) (hJ : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_riemann_pi)
    (hT1 : Buthe.v1.table_1_interval_bounds) (hT2 : Buthe.v1.table_2_interval_bounds)
    (hL : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_pi) (hU : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_gt_pi)
    (hS : Buthe2016.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_pi)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : (620000000000:ℝ) ≤ x) :
    certifiedMargin620 x*x^2/(log x)^6 ≤
      exp 1*x/log x*primeCounting (x/exp 1)-(primeCounting x)^2 := by
  have hr := actual_ramanujan_620b_profile hRH hGM hP hJ hT1 hT2 hL hU hS hx
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hl : 0 < log x := log_pos (by linarith)
  have hp : 0 < log x^6/x^2 := by positivity
  have he : (log x^6/x^2)*(certifiedMargin620 x*x^2/(log x)^6)=certifiedMargin620 x := by
    field_simp [hx0.ne',hl.ne']
  change certifiedMargin620 x*x^2/(log x)^6 ≤ RamanujanGap.v1.gap x
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hp).mp
  rw [he]
  exact hr


theorem actual_ramanujan_strict620 (hRH : SharedRH.hypothesis) (hGM : GM_Q_Theorem1_1)
    (hP : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_psi) (hJ : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_riemann_pi)
    (hT1 : Buthe.v1.table_1_interval_bounds) (hT2 : Buthe.v1.table_2_interval_bounds)
    (hL : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_pi) (hU : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_gt_pi)
    (hS : Buthe2016.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_pi)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : (620000000000:ℝ) ≤ x) :
    (primeCounting x)^2 < exp 1*x/log x*primeCounting (x/exp 1) := by
  have h := actual_prime_counting_gap620 hRH hGM hP hJ hT1 hT2 hL hU hS hx
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hl : 0 < log x := log_pos (by linarith)
  have hm : 0 < certifiedMargin620 x := by
    unfold certifiedMargin620 sourceCertifiedMargin
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hp : 0 < certifiedMargin620 x*x^2/(log x)^6 := by positivity
  linarith
#print axioms actual_ramanujan_strict620
#print axioms retains_original_margin
#print axioms actual_ramanujan_620b_profile
#print axioms actual_prime_counting_gap620
end RHLimit.Ram620

lemma table1_bridge (hT : Buthe.v1.table_1_interval_bounds)
    {z : ℝ} (hcut : (620000000000:ℝ) ≤ exp z) (hcap : exp z ≤ 640000000000) :
    (-88/100:ℝ) ≤ psiDeficit z ∧ psiDeficit (z-1) ≤ (68/100:ℝ) := by
  have hL := (hT ((320000000000:ℝ),(-88/100:ℝ),(78/100:ℝ))
    (by norm_num [Buthe.v1.table_1]) (exp z) (by linarith) (by norm_num; linarith)).1
  have he : exp (z-1)*exp 1 = exp z := by rw [←exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  have he1 : (2:ℝ) < exp 1 ∧ exp 1 < 3 := by constructor <;> interval_decide 80 (trust := kernel)
  have hx1 : (160000000000:ℝ) ≤ exp (z-1) := by nlinarith [exp_pos (z-1)]
  have hx2 : exp (z-1) ≤ (320000000000:ℝ) := by nlinarith [exp_pos (z-1)]
  have hU := (hT ((160000000000:ℝ),(-88/100:ℝ),(68/100:ℝ))
    (by norm_num [Buthe.v1.table_1]) (exp (z-1)) hx1 (by norm_num; linarith)).2
  constructor
  · simpa only [psiDeficit,←Real.exp_half] using hL
  · simpa only [psiDeficit,←Real.exp_half] using hU

lemma actual_deficits (hRH : SharedRH.hypothesis) (hGM : GM_Q_Theorem1_1)
    (hP : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_psi) (hJ : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_riemann_pi)
    (hT : Buthe.v1.table_1_interval_bounds)
    (hL : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_pi) (hU : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_gt_pi)
    {l u z c d : ℝ} (hl : 27 ≤ l) (hu : u ≤ 42) (hlz : l ≤ z) (hzu : z ≤ u)
    (hcut : (620000000000:ℝ) ≤ exp z) (hcap : exp z ≤ 640000000000)
    (hc : c ≤ -88/100-shift l u+lowerPowers l u)
    (hd : 68/100+shift (l-1) (u-1)+upperPowers (l-1) ≤ d) :
    c ≤ deficit z ∧ deficit (z-1) ≤ d := by
  have ht := table1_bridge hT hcut hcap
  have hb := abs_le.mp (refined_deficit_band hRH hGM hP hJ (by linarith : 12 ≤ l) hlz hzu)
  have hb' := abs_le.mp (refined_deficit_band hRH hGM hP hJ
    (by linarith : 12 ≤ l-1) (by linarith : l-1 ≤ z-1) (by linarith : z-1 ≤ u-1))
  have hp := powers_lower hL (by linarith : 26 ≤ l) hlz hzu hu
  have hp' := powers_upper hU (by linarith : 26 ≤ l-1)
    (by linarith : l-1 ≤ z-1) (by linarith : z-1 ≤ 42)
  have he := deficit_split z
  have he' := deficit_split (z-1)
  constructor <;> linarith

noncomputable def enhancedMargin (l u c d : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  fullBase u-d*l^5/(l-1)*exp ((1-l)/2)+
    2*pN 20 u*c*u^4*exp (-u/2)-c^2*l^4*exp (-l)

lemma enhanced_slab {l u z c d : ℝ} (hl : 27 ≤ l)
    (hlz : l ≤ z) (hzu : z ≤ u) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d)
    (hc : c ≤ deficit z) (hd : deficit (z-1) ≤ d) :
    enhancedMargin l u c d ≤ RamStudy.RG (exp z) := by
  have hz27 : (27:ℝ) ≤ z := hl.trans hlz
  have hbase := actual_source_base hz27
  rw [sourceBase_eq (by linarith : z ≠ 0)] at hbase
  have h := actual_signed_gap (show 1 < z by linarith) hbase hc hd
  have hB := fullBase_antitone (show 0 < z by linarith) hzu
  have hwF := weight_antitone (a:=l) (b:=(1/2:ℝ)) (by linarith) (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hF1 := hwF hlz (hlz.trans hzu) hzu
  have hF := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF1 hc0
  have hwQ := weight_antitone (a:=l) (b:=(1:ℝ)) (by linarith) (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hQ1 := hwQ (show l ∈ Ici l by simp) hlz hlz
  have hQ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ1 (sq_nonneg c)
  have hH := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (shift_antitone hl hz27 hlz) hd0
  have hw : pN 20 u ≤ RamStudy.w z :=
    (pN_antitone (by linarith : 0 < z) hzu 20).trans (by
      simpa only [actual_w_eq] using (actual_factorial_barrier26 (by linarith : 26 ≤ z)).1)
  have hF0 : 0 ≤ c*weight (1/2) u := by unfold weight; positivity
  have hw0 : 0 ≤ RamStudy.w z := by
    have hu0 : 0 < u := by linarith
    have hn : 0 ≤ pN 20 u := by unfold pN; positivity
    exact hn.trans hw
  have hprod := mul_le_mul hw hF hF0 hw0
  unfold enhancedMargin weight shiftWeight at *
  norm_num only [one_mul,neg_one_mul] at *
  have hnz : -(1/2:ℝ)*z = -z/2 := by ring
  have hnu : -(1/2:ℝ)*u = -u/2 := by ring
  simp only [hnz,hnu] at *
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at h hB hH hQ hprod ⊢
  nlinarith only [h,hB,hH,hQ,hprod]

noncomputable def lowerNoMax (l u : ℝ) : ℝ := pN 8 (u/2)-q (l/2)*exp (-l/4)+
  ∑ k ∈ range 3, exp (-u*(1/2-1/(k+3:ℝ)))*(p3 (u/(k+3))-q (l/(k+3))*exp (-l/(2*(k+3))))
lemma lowerNoMax_le (l u : ℝ) : lowerNoMax l u ≤ lowerPowers l u := by
  unfold lowerNoMax lowerPowers
  apply add_le_add le_rfl
  apply sum_le_sum
  intro k hk
  unfold lowRoot
  push_cast
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right _ _) (exp_pos _).le
#print axioms actual_deficits
#print axioms enhanced_slab
end RHLimit.Ram620

lemma refined_deficit_band (hRH : SharedRH.hypothesis) (hGM : GM_Q_Theorem1_1)
    (hP : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_psi) (hJ : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_riemann_pi)
    {l u z : ℝ} (hl : 12 ≤ l) (hlz : l ≤ z) (hzu : z ≤ u) :
    |riemannDeficit z-psiDeficit z| ≤ shift l u := by
  have hz : 0 < z := by linarith
  have h := actual_J_refined_GM hRH hGM hP hJ
    (show exp 12 ≤ exp z from exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))
  unfold refinedBound refinedLeading at h
  rw [Real.log_exp,←Real.exp_half] at h
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (show 0 ≤ z/exp (z/2) by positivity)
  have heq : riemannDeficit z-psiDeficit z =
      -(riemannPrimeCounting (exp z)-li (exp z)-(Chebyshev.psi (exp z)-exp z)/z)*(z/exp (z/2)) := by
    unfold riemannDeficit psiDeficit
    field_simp [hz.ne',exp_ne_zero]
    ring
  rw [heq,abs_mul,abs_neg,abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ z/exp (z/2) by positivity)]
  have hr : (361/25+(693/5000:ℝ)*exp (z/2)/(z*(z-6)))*(z/exp (z/2)) =
      (361/25:ℝ)*z*exp (-z/2)+(693/5000:ℝ)/(z-6) := by
    rw [show -z/2 = -(z/2) by ring,exp_neg]
    field_simp [hz.ne',show z-6 ≠ 0 by linarith,exp_ne_zero]
  change |riemannPrimeCounting (exp z)-li (exp z)-(Chebyshev.psi (exp z)-exp z)/z| * (z/exp (z/2)) ≤ _
  apply hm.trans
  change (361/25+(693/5000:ℝ)*exp (z/2)/(z*(z-6)))*(z/exp (z/2)) ≤ _
  rw [hr]
  have hd : (693/5000:ℝ)/(z-6) ≤ (693/5000:ℝ)/(l-6) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hE : exp (-z/2) ≤ exp (-l/2) := exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  -- the left factor uses the slab upper endpoint, independently of exp monotonicity
  have hM' : z*exp (-z/2) ≤ u*exp (-l/2) :=
    mul_le_mul hzu hE (exp_pos _).le (by linarith)
  unfold shift
  linarith

namespace RHLimit.Ram620
open Real Set Finset IEANTN RamanujanPV.AnalyticTransition

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

noncomputable def lowRoot (l u : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  exp (-u*(1/2-1/(n:ℝ)))*max 0 (p3 (u/n)-q (l/n)*exp (-l/(2*n)))
noncomputable def lowerPowers (l u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  pN 8 (u/2)-q (l/2)*exp (-l/4)+∑ k ∈ range 3, lowRoot l u (k+3)
noncomputable def highRoot (l : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (pN 1 (l/n)+6/(l/n)^2)*exp (-l*(1/2-1/(n:ℝ)))
noncomputable def upperPowers (l : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  pN 8 (l/2)+5*362880/(l/2)^9+
    (∑ k ∈ range 3, highRoot l (k+3))+
    (8/5:ℝ)*(∑ k ∈ range 5, exp (-l*(1/2-1/(k+6:ℝ))))+
    (512/5:ℝ)*exp (-l*(1/2-1/11))

lemma count_nonneg (s : ℝ) : 0 ≤ RamStudy.count s := by
  unfold RamStudy.count
  by_cases hs : 0 ≤ s
  · exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hs (exp_pos _).le) (RamanujanPV.primeCounting_nonneg _)
  · have he : exp s < 2 := (exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (lt_of_not_ge hs)).trans (by norm_num)
    rw [primeCounting_zero_of_lt_two (exp_pos s).le he]
    simp
lemma root_nonneg (z : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ rootTerm z n := by
  rw [rootTerm_normalized]
  exact mul_nonneg (count_nonneg _) (exp_pos _).le

lemma root_lower (hB : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_pi)
    {l u z : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hl : 26 ≤ l) (hlz : l ≤ z) (hzu : z ≤ u) (hu : u ≤ 42)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hn5 : n ≤ 5) : lowRoot l u n ≤ rootTerm z n := by
  have hn3 : (3:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hn5' : (n:ℝ) ≤ 5 := by exact_mod_cast hn5
  have hn0 : (0:ℝ) < n := by linarith
  have hs5 : 5 ≤ z/n := (le_div_iff₀ hn0).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hs42 : z/n ≤ 42 := (div_le_iff₀ hn0).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hroot : 2 ≤ exp (z/n) := exp_one_gt_two.le.trans (exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))
  have hd := source_deficit_upper hB (by linarith : 0 < z/n) hroot hs42
  have hc := actual_count_lower hd
  have hw := actual_p3_lower5 hs5
  rw [pN3_eq,actual_w_eq] at hw
  have hp := p3_antitone (by positivity : 0 < z/n) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hzu hn0.le)
  have hq := q_antitone (by positivity : 0 < l/n) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlz hn0.le)
  have he : exp (-(z/n)/2) ≤ exp (-l/(2*n)) := by
    apply exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hh := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlz (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2*(n:ℝ))
    have hre : -(z/(n:ℝ))/2 = -(z/(2*(n:ℝ))) := by ring
    rw [hre]
    simpa only [neg_div] using neg_le_neg hh
  have hprod := mul_le_mul hq he (exp_pos _).le (q_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ l/n))
  have hcount : max 0 (p3 (u/n)-q (l/n)*exp (-l/(2*n))) ≤ RamStudy.count (z/n) := by
    apply max_le (count_nonneg _)
    linarith
  have hfac : exp (-u*(1/2-1/(n:ℝ))) ≤ exp (z/n-z/2) := by
    apply exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hi : 1/(n:ℝ) ≤ (1/3:ℝ) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hn3
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hzu (show 0 ≤ 1/2-1/(n:ℝ) by linarith)
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at hh ⊢
    nlinarith
  unfold lowRoot
  rw [rootTerm_normalized,mul_comm (RamStudy.count _)]
  exact mul_le_mul hfac hcount (le_max_left _ _) (exp_pos _).le

lemma powers_lower (hB : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_minus_pi)
    {l u z : ℝ} (hl : 26 ≤ l) (hlz : l ≤ z) (hzu : z ≤ u) (hu : u ≤ 42) :
    lowerPowers l u ≤ primePart z := by
  have hz : 0 < z := by linarith
  have hroot : 2 ≤ exp (z/2) := exp_one_gt_two.le.trans (exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))
  have hd := source_deficit_upper hB (by linarith : 0 < z/2) hroot (by linarith : z/2 ≤ 42)
  have hc := actual_count_lower hd
  have hw := (actual_p8 (show 13 ≤ z/2 by linarith)).1
  have hp := pN_antitone (show 0 < z/2 by linarith) (show z/2 ≤ u/2 by linarith) 8
  have hq := q_antitone (show 0 < l/2 by linarith) (show l/2 ≤ z/2 by linarith)
  have he : exp (-(z/2)/2) ≤ exp (-l/4) := exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hprod := mul_le_mul hq he (exp_pos _).le (q_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ l/2))
  have hsquare : pN 8 (u/2)-q (l/2)*exp (-l/4) ≤ rootTerm z 2 := by
    rw [rootTerm_normalized]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat,sub_self,exp_zero,mul_one]
    linarith
  have hsmall : (∑ k ∈ range 3, lowRoot l u (k+3)) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ range 3, rootTerm z (k+3) := by
    apply sum_le_sum
    intro k hk
    exact root_lower hB hl hlz hzu hu (by omega) (by have := mem_range.mp hk; omega)
  have hsum : (∑ k ∈ range 4, rootTerm z (k+2)) ≤ primePart z := by
    rw [primePart_terms hz.le (hzu.trans hu)]
    apply sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (range_mono (by omega : 4 ≤ 63))
    intro k _ _
    exact root_nonneg z (k+2)
  rw [show (4:ℕ)=3+1 by rfl,sum_range_succ'] at hsum
  norm_num only [Nat.zero_add] at hsum
  have hh : (∑ k ∈ range 3, rootTerm z (k+1+2)) = ∑ k ∈ range 3, rootTerm z (k+3) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    congr 1 <;> omega
  rw [hh] at hsum
  unfold lowerPowers
  linarith

lemma root_upper_small (hB : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_gt_pi)
    {l z : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hl : 26 ≤ l) (hlz : l ≤ z) (hz42 : z ≤ 42)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hn5 : n ≤ 5) : rootTerm z n ≤ highRoot l n := by
  have hn3 : (3:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hn5' : (n:ℝ) ≤ 5 := by exact_mod_cast hn5
  have hn0 : (0:ℝ) < n := by linarith
  have hs5 : 5 ≤ z/n := (le_div_iff₀ hn0).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hs42 : z/n ≤ 42 := (div_le_iff₀ hn0).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hroot : 2 ≤ exp (z/n) := exp_one_gt_two.le.trans (exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))
  have hd := source_deficit_pos hB (by linarith : 0 < z/n) hroot hs42
  have hc := actual_count_upper hd.le
  have hw := (actual_p1 hs5).2
  have hp := pN_antitone (by positivity : 0 < l/n) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlz hn0.le) 1
  have h2 := invpow_antitone (by positivity : 0 < l/n) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlz hn0.le) 2
  have hcount : RamStudy.count (z/n) ≤ pN 1 (l/n)+6/(l/n)^2 := by
    have hpos : 0 ≤ deficit (z/n)*exp (-(z/n)/2) := mul_nonneg hd.le (exp_pos _).le
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,zero_mul,sub_zero] at hw h2 hp hc ⊢
    linarith
  have he : exp (z/n-z/2) ≤ exp (-l*(1/2-1/(n:ℝ))) := by
    apply exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hi : 1/(n:ℝ) ≤ (1/3:ℝ) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hn3
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlz (show 0 ≤ 1/2-1/(n:ℝ) by linarith)
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at hh ⊢
    nlinarith
  rw [rootTerm_normalized]
  unfold highRoot
  exact mul_le_mul hcount he (exp_pos _).le (by unfold pN; positivity)

lemma powers_upper (hB : Buthe.v1.theorem_2_li_gt_pi)
    {l z : ℝ} (hl : 26 ≤ l) (hlz : l ≤ z) (hz42 : z ≤ 42) :
    primePart z ≤ upperPowers l := by
  have hz : 0 < z := by linarith
  have hroot : 2 ≤ exp (z/2) := exp_one_gt_two.le.trans (exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))
  have hsq := square_term_upper hB hz hz42 hroot
  have hw := (actual_p8 (by linarith : 13 ≤ z/2)).2
